# Free Exercise DB (external dataset)

Source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db

Place the combined dataset here:

```text
data/external/free-exercise-db/exercises.json
```

Obtain it from:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/main/dist/exercises.json
```

Override path with env `FREE_EXERCISE_DB_PATH` or CLI `--path`.

Used by: `pnpm run import:exercises`
